hits.snippet: ASSA ABLOY expands its entrance control portfolio with Gunnebo acquisition ASSA ABLOY has signed an agreement to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control, a global provider of speed gates, mass transit gates, and security revolving doors. The deal will see Gunnebo join ASSA ABLOY's Entrance Systems Division under the Pedestrian business segment. Formed in 1995 with roots dating back to 1764, Gunnebo Entrance Control brings 670 employees, manufacturing across Europe, the US and Asia, and 2025 sales of approximately €151 million with a strong EBIT margin. The combination significantly strengthens ASSA ABLOY's pedestrian access solutions offering. [...] Today, we are excited to share that Gunnebo Group, owned by Altor and Stena Adactum AB, has entered into an agreement to divest its Gunnebo Entrance Control business to ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. Gunnebo Entrance Control is a leading provider of entrance control solutions, and the transaction marks an important milestone in Gunnebo Group's strategic development. Following completion, the group will focus exclusively on Gunnebo Safe Storage, where owners and management have an ambitious agenda for future growth. [.

Gunnebo Entrance Control has acquired Shuretech Ltd., integrating the company’s field engineering expertise and service-led operating model into its United Kingdom business. Founded in 2011, Shuretech specializes in the installation, maintenance, and lifecycle support of solutions, including gates, barriers, turnstiles, and shutters. The company primarily operates across the South East of England, focusing on preventative maintenance and fault resolution. Founded in 2009 in Aarhus with a new branch in Copenhagen, Special Montering is known for delivering locks, door automation, and access management solutions across sectors including commercial offices, public buildings, industrial sites, and infrastructure projects.
